The Dark Truth Of Instagram - Mastermind Mark Zuckerberg

Uncovering the history of Instagram Right from Kevin Systrom's initial app idea which was named on the whiskey brand Burbn, to becoming a multi-billion dollar business that has entirely impacted & changed the world. We'll not only cover how Instagram began, but also how Instagram proliferated and got famous, the details of Masterplan by Mastermind Zuckerberg & Facebook's acquisition of Instagram, some of the many problems that Instagram has faced, and also how The Founder Kevin Systrom himself ended up quitting the company he has created. The story of Instagram is truly a wild ride - in many ways it's a business & entrepreneurial success story, in other ways it feels more like a horror story when you consider some of the negative impacts Instagram has had on society. But either way, Instagram's history is fascinating to watch!
